components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with glowing hover transition.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #06b6d4; color: #0a0a0a; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Translucent glassmorphic container for itinerary items.
components.html:
Tokyo Itinerary

Day 1: Shibuya & Shinjuku Night Walk
components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; color: #ededed; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #06b6d4; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #a3a3a3; }

narrative.overview: Globe-Trotter embodies a dark-mode first, high-precision visual atmosphere inspired by digital cartography and night-sky navigation. Deep obsidian backgrounds are paired with glowing cyan and indigo accents.

rules.name: The Luminescence Rule
rules.body: Accent colors are reserved for focal points and CTAs, covering ≤15% of viewport.

rules.name: The Glass-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is created primarily through backdrop blur and subtle border contrast.

dos: Do maintain translucent glassmorphism for floating overlays.
Do use Geist Mono for coordinates, dates, and prices.
donts: Don't use opaque heavy black drop-shadows.
Don't saturate screens with cyan/indigo accents.
